## About

I'm Levente Otta, known online as Otisz, a Senior Fullstack Developer based in Budapest, Hungary. I have been building web applications professionally since 2017, and I currently work at Bit Different on [myPlan.cloud](https://myplan.cloud), a construction project management platform.

Most of my work is business software: CRM (Customer Relationship Management), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) and PMS (Property Management Software) platforms, insurance and donation systems, and an AI-powered customer service chatbot. On the backend I mainly use PHP with Laravel and Node.js with NestJS. On the frontend I work with React and TypeScript, as well as Vue.js and Svelte.

I have led the architecture and full rewrite of a legacy application into a multi-tenant platform, designed microservice backends, and set standards for testing, code quality and CI/CD. I also review code, mentor junior developers, and maintain open-source Laravel packages such as [laravel-imgix](https://packagist.org/packages/otisz/laravel-imgix) and [laravel-billingo](https://packagist.org/packages/otisz/laravel-billingo).

## Experience

### Senior Fullstack Developer, Bit Different Ltd. (Sep. 2026 - Present)

Working on myPlan.cloud, a cloud-based construction project management platform that brings task management, document management and BIM (Building Information Modeling) model viewing into one place for construction teams.

- Building frontend features with Svelte.
- Working on the backend with PHP.
- Developing the mobile app with Capacitor.

### Senior Fullstack Developer, Bannerse (Mar. 2025 - Jan. 2026)

Led the architecture and a full rewrite of a legacy Vue.js application into a scalable, multi-tenant platform.

- Built React applications with TanStack Router, Query, Form and Store.
- Integrated WebSockets to deliver real-time data to users.

- Established standards for testing, code quality and CI/CD workflows.
